author: Bus-404-Found
_comments: No HUB75 panel is wired here, and none can be: Wokwi does not implement
I2S, which is the peripheral the panel driver uses. The sim environment
builds with USE_SERIAL_RENDERER=1 so the rows arrive on the serial monitor
flashSize must be 8. The LittleFS partition starts at 0x670000 in the 8 MB
table this firmware is built against, so a 4 MB simulated flash cannot
contain it and the mount fails -- reported by the firmware as a config
error, which points nowhere near the real cause.
psram mirrors board_build.arduino.memory_type = qio_opi in platformio.ini.
If the simulated board fails early in boot, removing the two psram
attributes is the first thing to try: the PlatformIO board definition for
this devkit reports no PSRAM, so the two disagree on real hardware too.
